findings.one_line: The supplied Proposition 2.2 statement establishes only R_2(G)=f_2(H_DTE(G)); it does not establish the node's stronger equality with a maximal-independent-set game, so narrow the node or supply a source/proof for that game equivalence.

cited_checks.note: The attested Proposition 2.1 states G' subseteq G implies R(G',tau,q) <= R(G,tau,q); H_P subseteq G with q=2 and the DTE is an exact instantiation.

The attested Proposition 2.2 says only that R(G,tau,q)=f_q(H) for the corresponding labelled conflict graph. It supports the final graph-functional consequence, but not the asserted equality to a maximal-independent-set game.
The attested Corollary D.1 gives exactly the displayed q=2 DTE lower terms 1/alpha(G) and sqrt(d_avg(G))/n and upper term (lambda(G)+1)/n, up to the stated universal comparison constants.
